scenarios.title: Nominal
scenarios.note: Over 100 samples per class on the nominal instrument: naive wrong on 8% of cancer / 8% of normal spectra, robust 8% / 8%, SVM 5% / 21%; QC rejects 0%.

scenarios.title: Laser drift +0.65 nm
scenarios.note: Over 100 samples per class at +0.65 nm: naive wrong on 20% of cancer / 4% of normal spectra, robust 10% / 6%, SVM 0% / 99%; QC rejects 1%.

scenarios.title: Strong fluorescence
scenarios.note: Over 100 samples per class at fluorescence 20x Raman: naive wrong on 10% of cancer / 28% of normal spectra, robust 16% / 15%, SVM 27% / 20%; QC rejects 22%.

scenarios.title: Room light
scenarios.note: Over 100 samples per class with room light 0.5: naive wrong on 0% of cancer / 86% of normal spectra, robust 9% / 16%, SVM 5% / 37%; QC rejects 100%, room light flagged on 100%.

reasons: room light: argon line at 912.3 nm

scenarios.title: Low signal
scenarios.note: Over 100 samples per class at 500 e-/s, 0.5 s, one accumulation: naive wrong on 41% of cancer / 43% of normal spectra, robust 26% / 57%, SVM 80% / 5%; QC rejects 100%, low SNR flagged on 100%.
